Topic.label: Volume and surface area of a sphere

Question:
When the radius of a sphere becomes 2 times its original value, how many times its original volume does the sphere have?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h112_q1_question_en.svg)
Solution: Volume is proportional to the cube of the radius: \(2^3=8\).
